en.ammaar-muslim: 1. [1/258] Rijal al-Kashshi: Ibrahim b. Muhammad al-Khatli from Ahmad b. Idris al-Qummi from Muhammad b. Ahmad from al-Hasan b. Ali al-Kufi from al-Abbas b. A’mir from Sayf b. Umayra from Jarud b. al-Mundhir from Abi Abdillah عليه السلام who said:
No Hashimite woman who was with us combed her hair or applied dye [colouring] to it – until al-Mukhtar sent to us the heads of those who killed al-Husayn عليه السلام.
